It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

It is the shrine from which the name of Kashiba City is said to derive<ref name="city-name">[https://www.city.kashiba.lg.jp/soshiki/5/3826.html 香芝市の沿革] - Kashiba City</ref>.

== Overview ==
It is enshrined near west of JR {{ill|Kashiba Station|eo|Stacio Kashiba|it|Stazione di Kashiba|ja|香芝駅|ko|가시바역|nl|Station Kashiba|ur|کاشیبا اسٹیشن|zh|香芝站|qid=Q3655907}}, and near north of {{ill|Kintetsu Shimoda Station|Q6414373|qid=Q6414373}} on the {{ill|Osaka Line|Q1052545|qid=Q1052545}}.

Its founding is said to begin in March {{ill|1172|Q19687|qid=Q19687}} ({{ill|Jōan (era)|Q1194188|qid=Q1194188|lt=Shōan}} 2), when {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kamada Masamitsu}}, son of {{ill|Kamata Masakiyo|Q11651065|qid=Q11651065}} (a retainer of {{ill|Minamoto no Yoshitomo|Q532301|qid=Q532301}}), invited the deity from {{ill|Kashima Jingū|Q706499|qid=Q706499}} in {{ill|Hitachi Province|cs|Provincie Hitači|de|Provinz Hitachi|es|Provincia de Hitachi|fa|ولایت هیتاچی|fr|Province de Hitachi|gl|Provincia de Hitachi|hak|Hitachi-koet|id|Provinsi Hitachi|it|Hitachi
